meta.audience: people who save more links than they ever read again
meta.title: Trove
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app itself: source/README.md and the app's own design tokens (src/index.css, read in the app repository), plus its first screen as captured. Black stage, chrome silver and one lime, Pretendard with tight tracking, monospaced upper-case labels; the chrome torus is the app's own drawing (lib/torus.ts), ported to the reel.

source.notes: what the app does: paste, auto tags and summary, boards, related links by cosine similarity
the real app (its built dist, served locally) captured by capture/app.json; sample data is the app's own fictional data
Pretendard Variable (the app's body face) and JetBrains Mono (labels); both SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's dark theme tokens as they are: bg #08090A, surface #111215/#17191D, text #EEEFF1/#B7BAC1/#8E929B and the single lime #C6F432 that marks what is new or important (the second line of its headline, 'new link' badges, the add button). The topic colours of the sample board (sky #8FD3FF, yellow #FFC94D, lilac #C9A8FF, mint #7EF0C4) are the supporting hues, used only where a topic is meant.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable, as in the app: headlines at 800 with -0.04em tracking, the second line in lime like the app's own masthead ('링크가 이어지면 / 지식이 돼요.'); labels in monospace capitals with wide tracking ('SCATTERED LINKS → ONE TROVE').
rationale.motion: Precise and weighty rather than bouncy: things are pulled, not thrown. Link chips drift in depth and get drawn into the torus's orbit; real cards settle with a short damped spring; connection lines draw on with a lime pulse travelling along them. Camera pushes are slow and continuous so no hold sits still.
rationale.sound: Dark synth in A minor at 128 BPM (exactly 8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s): a cool, minor-ish pulse that suits a black-and-lime tool, with digital SFX (ticks for chips, blips for found URLs, draw-on tones for the connections).
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: scattered links pulled into the chrome torus as the name lands; the real paste dialog finding the URLs in a chat; real cards joined by lime lines through the tags they share; the end card. The 30 s cut adds auto tags and summary from the real link form, and the real search.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short launch reel for a personal tool whose copy is slogan-length Korean, shown as type; it plays muted at the top of a README or a market card.
